lines.scene: You again. In the yard.
Don't name it. I won't either.
The flower opens because it can.
It falls because it must.
I still watched the whole thing.
Yushin. Your face does that thing.
Stop counting me. I'm not grain.
You are. That's the trouble.
Come closer. No, not for the court.
For the second before someone sees.
I know which marshal I will not keep.
You know which princess you will not say.
We are ridiculous. Stay.
If I brush your sleeve, it was wind.
If you don't move, it was courage.
Bloom.
I like you better unranked.
You like me better unwise.
Fall.
I will not make a spectacle.
I will make a memory and deny it.
Your hand is warmer than duty.
Don't you dare be noble.
Ask me again without a title.
Princess. Marshal. Useless words.
Look. The petal's already down.
Pick it up or leave it.
Either way you thought of me.
I thought of you at the count.
Lost it. Happy?
Again tomorrow. Same yard.
Same lie. Same step closer.
If the flower can do this twice
so can we, badly, on purpose.
Don't bow.
Smile like you mean the trouble.
I do.
When it falls, don't write a poem.
Catch me before the ministers do.
Too late. You already did.
Good.
Again.
The petal, the yard, us.
Stay.
